candidates.title: Aphelios Flex
candidates.tips: Core units are Aphelios + Diana + Sentinel + Mama Beak. This is a variation of Aphelios to play with AP items instead of melee items. Red Buff is BIS Aphelios but you can also play Rageblade build. Frontline is either Amumu+Scuttlecrab or Sett + Krug.

stages.text: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

candidates.title: Ashe Dragon Fast 9
candidates.tips: Prioritize Ashe items > Tank items > leftover duo carry items (ideally Elder Dragon). Comp is very expensive so make sure you take good econ augments.

stages.text: Slam items aggressively and play around 3 Blossom for a win streak. This is a comp you can only play from far ahead with lots of HP and resources.
Continue your win streak. Pick an econ augment if you have not already. Otherwise, take item augments and push levels.
If you have 80+ HP, you can consider losing Stage 4 and focus purely on economy. Aim to Fast 9 by end of Stage 4 / 5-1 and transition your board.

candidates.title: Trait Ladder
candidates.tips: Hard flex composition, but very strong when played well. Any emblem start is fine. Get Khazix 10 takedowns for ravager evolution while gathering the early 2-8 trait cashouts in the midgame. The key interval to plan for is 10 traits for the Tactician Crown -> pivot to legendaries or go for even more cashouts if healthy.

stages.text: Ideally start with Khazix to get 10 takedowns ASAP. Add in the cheap 1-2 cost units to activate traits. Otherwise, flex around your best upgraded unit.
Continue adding and flexing in more traits. +1 team size augments like Coronation or Cursed Crown are very OP here.
After you hit 11 traits, add Amumu with the Tactician's Crown you get and then level for Kennen. Then pivot to 5 costs at level 9.

candidates.title: Dark Ritual Elise Reroll
candidates.tips: Play with Dark Ritual augment to convert cash out -> AP. Ideally ply for a 250+ cashout for AP first, then take 40s if you need for more stacking. 2x Morgana 2* with items on both is the best way to cap your board.

stages.text: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence. It is actually better to win early than lose for stacks so don't overly force lose streak.
Level to 6 and roll for a Elise 2, Covens, and Vanguards. Give Cassio or Diana leftover AP. Cash out Coven and convert to AP with at least 2-3 lives (25-30 hp).
Finish Elise 3 / Cassio 3 then level for more Vanguards or Lunar. Play 2 Morganas with items if you have extra.

candidates.title: Fae Tristana Reroll
candidates.tips: Only play when you have Fae emblem. Stacking 4 Fae ASAP is important so you can get a gold engine. Can also tank Vi primary if you can't find Rammus. Execute Primal > Item Primal unless very far ahead / win streaking.

stages.text: Play for win streak with upgraded Rageblade holder. Start stacking Fae since getting to 7 ASAP is crucial for success.
Itemize and play Tristana as soon as you find her. Sprykin is more important than Hunter. If you spike very early Primal from ahead, you can consider items.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Tristana and Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Give Sivir leftover AD items.
